name: workflow-platform
description: Éditeur de workflows exécutables pour l'agriculture de précision (outil interne).

scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @workflow/shared && npm run db:seed -w @workflow/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @workflow/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,api,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @workflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @workflow/api" "npm run dev -w @workflow/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @workflow/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @workflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
